decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original approval of application ref: P/3440/22 dated: 09/02/2023.

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span style="line-height: 107%;">The development shall be operated in accordance with the Fire Statement &nbsp;approved under application P/1223/23.</span></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><br></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span style="line-height: 107%;">The development shall be constructed in accordance with the Materials &nbsp;&nbsp;approved under application P/1223/23.</span></p><p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><br></p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><p><span style="line-height: normal;">3511-01/FP; 3511-02/FP; 3511-03/FP; 3511-04/FP; 3511-05A/FP Rev A; 3511-06A/FP Rev A; 3511-07A/FP Rev B; 3511-08A/FP Rev B; 3511-09A/FP Rev B; 3511-10A/FP 3511-11A/FP Rev A; 3511-12A/FP; Arboricultural Impact Assessment November 2022</span></p>

<p><span style="line-height: normal;">Prior to the first occupation of the development, evidence of Secured by Design Certification shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing to be agreed, or justification shall be submitted where the accreditation requirements cannot be met. Secure by design measures shall be implemented and the development shall be retained in accordance with the approved details.</span><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span style="line-height: 107%;">The development shall be operated in accordance with the bin and cycle stores &nbsp;approved under application P/1223/23.</span></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><br></p><p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><br></p>

<p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span style="line-height: 107%;">The development hereby permitted shall be used for Class C3 dwellinghouse(s) only and notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take place.</span></p><p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><br></p>

<p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span style="line-height: 107%;">Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development in relation to the proposed dwellinghouse which would otherwise fall within Classes A and B in Part 1 of Schedule 2, and Class AA of Part 20 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority. </span></p><p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span style="line-height: 107%;">The development shall be maintained in accordance with the Landscape Master Plan &nbsp;approved under application P/1223/23.</span></p><p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height: normal;">All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of&nbsp; landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building, or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.&nbsp; Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.</span></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><br></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span style="line-height: 107%;">The development shall be constructed in accordance with the disposal of sewage &nbsp;details &nbsp;approved under application P/1223/23 and retained thereafter.</span></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><br></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span style="line-height: 107%;">The development shall be operated in accordance with the disposal of surface water details &nbsp;approved under application P/1223/23 and retained thereafter.</span></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height: normal;">The tree protection measures hereby approved shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved Arboricultural Report before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.&nbsp;&nbsp; Nothing shall be stored or placed&nbsp; in any area fenced in accordance with this condition, and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.</span></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><br></p>

<p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height: normal;">Site works in connection with the development hereby permitted shall not commence before the boundary of the site is enclosed by a close boarded or other security fence to a minimum height of 2 metres. Such fencing shall remain until works and clearance have been completed, and the development is ready for occupation. </span></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><br></p>
description: Variation of Condition 2 (Approved plans) attached to planning permission P/3440/22 dated 09/02/2023 to allow an infill extension to first floor side extension and the removal of glazing bars from the proposed elevations
